title: Tuned values cannot be made the real render
tier_reason: The sliders re-render into hq/data/loop_previews/ and never touch tools/experiments/out/.
ask: The sliders re-render into hq/data/loop_previews/ and never touch tools/experiments/out/. There is no way to say 'these are the values now' except running the script by hand at a terminal, which is the recurring manual step the studio is supposed to be removing. Add the promotion: write the tuned values into the loop's own out/ directory, and record what changed so the move is legible afterwards.
first_action: Add a control that promotes the current preview to the loop's committed render, writing the values it used alongside it
source_message: Filed 2026-09-08 when Daniel asked whether there is now a system for adding animations to the Design Studio's animation page. The answer was most of one; these are the places it is not closed.
